invariants.rationale: The method is called with a Tooltip, which is likely expected to be non-null as it is immediately used.
The method sets showTooltip = tooltip at the start; this relationship should hold at method exit.
The inner logic is only executed if this condition is true, indicating it is significant for the method's effect.
If both enabled and tooltip.always are false, no additional effect besides assigning showTooltip. Enforces logical relationship.
If time == 0 or tooltip.instant, showTask.run() is called, hence not scheduled. Else, it may be scheduled with Timer.schedule.
